h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Firozabad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Firozabad

items.pText: Firozabad has made glass and bangles for generations, and in a town known for colour it makes sense to think about the colour of a play area early. FunPlay Systems designs and moulds its play equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and we offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Schools, colonies and parks in Firozabad can choose a combination that suits their building or theme.

Roto-moulded colour runs through the whole thickness of the plastic, so it does not peel or chip the way paint does. That matters in western Uttar Pradesh, where summer sun and dust wear down painted surfaces quickly. We deliver every order to Firozabad by road and install it with our own team or a dealer, on a self-standing base or grouted into the ground.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Pick two or three main colours and repeat them across the play area, rather than giving every piece a different shade. The space will look planned, and replacement parts are easier to match later. Lighter colours stay cooler in direct sun, which suits slides and decks. Brighter accents work well on panels and roofs, where children's hands do not rest for long. Our design team can also customise a structure to a school's theme.

items.q: How many colours can we choose from?
items.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Tell us your preferred colours or school theme, and we will suggest a combination for each piece on the layout.

items.q: Will the colour of roto-moulded parts peel?
items.a: The colour is part of the plastic itself, so it does not peel or chip like paint. Like any outdoor material, it can fade slowly over years in strong sun.

items.q: Can you customise a design for our school?
items.a: Yes. Our in-house design team can adapt structures to your requirements. Send us your ideas along with the site size and the age group of the children.
